definitions.explanation: A professional performer of {落語|らくご}, the traditional Japanese art of comic storytelling. The performer kneels alone on stage in a kimono, narrates a long humorous story, and plays all characters by changing voice and direction of gaze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{落語家|らくごか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{落語家|らくごか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたくて→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧{入|い}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He wanted to become a rakugo performer, so he became an apprentice.

examples.japanese: {落語家|らくごか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{扇子|せんす}→扇子：04039_sensu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手拭|てぬぐ}い→手拭い：06123_tenugui⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登場人物|とうじょうじんぶつ}→登場人物：16072_toujoujinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{演|えん}じ{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: Rakugo performers play many different characters using only a fan and a hand towel.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ (rakugo) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (practitioner, professional). {落語家|らくごか} follow a strict ranking system: ⟦{見習|みなら}い→見習い：18735_minarai⟧ → {前座|ぜんざ} → ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧つ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ → {真打|しんうち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落語家|らくごか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a rakugo performer
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{落語家|らくごか}: popular rakugo performer
- {落語家|らくごか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{弟子入|でしい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apprentice oneself to a rakugo performer

CULTURAL NOTE:
A rakugo performer's stage name is given by their master and changes as they rise through the ranks. The two main professional associations are {落語協会|らくごきょうかい} and {落語芸術協会|らくごげいじゅつきょうかい} in Tokyo.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧: entertainer; comedian — broader category that includes modern stand-up
- ⟦{噺家|はなしか}→噺家：21666_hanashika⟧: storyteller — an older, more traditional term for the same profession
